description: On the tabletop there’s a pink bowl near the back, a small white cup holding a yellow egg-shaped object in the middle, and other small items like a blue container, a plush keychain, and a colorful block off to the side. The left hand stays resting near the left edge, while the right hand reaches in from the right, pinches and lifts the yellow object out of the small cup, moves it upward and slightly back toward the pink bowl, then lowers it into the bowl and releases it, leaving the right hand hovering nearby.
